description: For a project using strapi-plugin-config-sync, read from the files (Strapi is not started, the database is not read): the plugin's version, its options and where each comes from (a short `excludedConfig` is merged index by index with the plugin's defaults, as Strapi does: the warnings say which defaults are no longer excluded), the sync directory, and its files by status — `ok`, `excluded` by the options, `invalid` (not valid JSON: config-sync can't read it), or of a type not registered here. `files: true` lists them with readable names ("View — Article", "Role Public"); `key` returns one file's content. What the database holds is not known here.

files.description: List every file (key, readable label, status). Default: counts by status.

from.description: A path inside the target project (e.g. the file you are editing). Disambiguates a multi-project workspace.

project.description: A project name (its folder) or root path. Use when you have no file path in hand.

name: config_sync_status
title: config-sync: its options and the files of its sync directory
